description: This Java class 'DefaultCachesConfig' implements the 'CachesConfig' interface for the Eclipse Ditto Concierge service. It manages cache configuration such as timeout durations and cache settings, and provides static methods for instantiation based on external configuration data.

classes.name: DefaultCachesConfig
classes.description: Immutable class that holds cache configuration details such as timeout durations and cache settings for the Ditto Concierge service.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultCachesConfig instance from a Typesafe Config object, applying fallback logic for missing configuration values.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured timeout duration for ask operations.

methods.name: getIdCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration for ID caching.

methods.name: getEnforcerCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration for enforcer caching.
